 When colliding with an enemy during Hover, you now deal low damage to them and knock them back. Damage and knockback scale with your momentum
Salvage Hook (R) 
 ‘Salvaging’ an enemy this way drops a Scrap Engine pickup for your allies, which restores +25% health and armor
Jin (formerly known as Stalker)
 "oh no he’s hot now" (think about this when you’re getting stabbed to death)
Ash'gara Warblade (LMB) (that’s the name of his weapon)
 No longer applies a mark on enemies (RMB Level 3 upgrade still applies the mark) 
 Reduced bonus armor shred by 1
 Added 0.1s winddown to attacks 
Flash Dagger (RMB)
 Visuals updated
 Damage at max range reduced 
Feylight Clone (R) 
 Clone now aims at cursor/is generally better at following orders 
Joule
 fridge.gif (sorry lol)
Lightning Strike (Q)
 Ability warmup  visuals updated to be much louder/noticeable
Voltaic Spear (RMB)
 Now does Explosive damage
Kingpin
Primal Slam (Q) 
 (NEW) Level 3 upgrade - Now applies up to +75% bonus damage based on Kingpin’s distance from the ground when cast.
 -- For reference, a Jump into Dash into Primal Slam will give around +30% bonus damage with this upgrade. It’s up to you to imagine how you can go even higher. 
Myth
 Some changes aimed at raising Myth’s skill floor while also throwing in some necessary nerfs. For those health changes specifically; as one of the most elusive Huntresses around, we think if she does get caught… that’s on you, dawg.
 Base Health lowered from 950 >>> 850 
 Health per Level lowered from 57 >>> 51
Greenwood Bow (LMB)
 Adjusted timing for Green shots to feel more linear (less of a pause in the middle) 
 Fixed a bug where Perfect Timing green shots were not going the full distance shown on the laser  
Heartpiercer (RMB) 
 Knockback amount is weighted much more towards charge time and less towards distance of shot. Meaning: you’ll knock back less with quick fires at close range than before, and knock back much more with full charge-ups at longer range
 Minimum charge time before firing 0.35s >>> 0.4s
 Can no longer hold infinitely, auto-fires after 1.9s (1.5s after warmup)
 (NEW) Level 3 upgrade - Now gains a charge of Phase Walk (Shift) whenever you successfully wallstun with Heartpiercer 
Rain of Arrows (Q) 
 Arc width increased up close, decreased at long range 
Oath
 Oath has had a big presence in the last few playtests - especially at high skill levels. With these changes we’re trying to nudge him closer to a tank/melee playstyle, while giving him some more interesting options for Level 3 ability upgrades.
 Toughness lowered from 7 >>> 6
Magnetic Hammer (LMB) 
 Now charges twice as fast 
 Damage ratios have been adjusted from 50% base damage / 50% ratios >>> 33% base damage / 66% ratios
Spin Dash (Shift)
 (NEW) Level 3 Upgrade changed - Hitting an enemy with Spin Dash resets Shield Bash (RMB) cooldown
Shiv
 As our premiere mechanics hunter, we should see Shiv’s relative power/winrate improve from low skill to high skill (meaning: she should see more success in high-skill games as a high-mechanics hunter), but this just isn’t true. We want to make it true. So here are changes to make it true.
Master Assassin (Passive)
 Increased Master Assassin stack duration from 4s >>> 5s
Arcslinger Pistols (LMB)
 Base damage reduced from 62 (32% AP) >>> 60 (30% AP)
 Empowered damage increased from 72 (+41% AP) >>> 74 (+41.5% AP)
 Damager per Master Assassin stack increased from 6.8 (+4.35% AP) >>> 8 (+4.75% AP) 
 -- With the changes to Master Assassin (Passive), Arcslinger Pistols does less damage at 0 - 2 Master Assassin (Passive) stacks, and more damage at 3+ stacks
Chain Bolas (RMB)
 (NEW) Level 3 Upgrade - Now applies 2 stacks of Master Assassin (Passive) to target hit
 No longer provides bonus 0.5s stun duration at Level 3
Quickflip (Shift)
 Base cooldown reduced from 7s >>> 6.5s (Level 3 still 5s) 
 Speed buff after using Quickflip increased from 7% >>> 11.5%
 -- Movespeed bonus properly gets removed when you take damage
Farstep Dagger (Q) 
 Now always applies a 50% slow to enemies
 (NEW) Level 3 Upgrade - Applies 2 stacks of Master Assassin (Passive) to target hit
Fusilade (R) 
 Damage decrease from 45 (+25% AP) >>> 42 (+22% AP) 
Shrike
Truetalon Rifle (LMB)
 Shrike can hold LMB to continuously fire her rifle 
Disengage (Shift)
Knocks always reset Disengage
 Level 3 upgrade causes the projectile to mark targets with her passive
Dive-Bomb (RMB)
 (NEW) Level 3 Upgrade - Lowers ability cooldown by 2s, and increases the Cremate burn rate of Wisps that it hits
 No longer grants a second charge at level 3
Scout Hawk (Q)
 (NEW) Level 3 Upgrade - Increased Vision Radius by 50%, duration increased to 40s
 No longer marks enemies (change from Veteran test)
Full Bore (R) 
 Projectile size increased by 50%
 Damage reduced by 33% 
Zeph
 During the last playtest, it was Zephrey's world, we were all just living in it. Today I am learning Zeph’s full name is Zephrey, and if it’s not, well, it is now. Anyway, we’re pulling back on Zeph’s raw healing output and looking to inject tools that require more skill to play optimally.
Mending Breeze (RMB)
 Heal amount lowered by 20%
 (NEW) Level 3 upgrade changed - Now grants a short movement speed to the target 
 No longer grants a 4th charge
[hr][/hr]
Quality-of-Life Changes & Bugfixes
WASD Cancelling
 Several actions are WASD cancellable, including placing Chonker Cannon, repairing Armor, Cooking food, Vaults, etc.)  
 Most actions are WASD cancellable 0.25s after the initial cast. Vaults are cancellable 0.5s after starting the Vault. 
Trees
 Trees now have a small volume in the middle of the tree that grants you the same effect as when you're in brush (hiding you from vision unless people are very close to you)
 This allows Forestwalking and Tree Costume to hide you properly and not sometimes make you visible if players are on higher elevation than you
Cast Range on Hover
 Hovering over an ability will display their cast ranges
Settings
 You can now toggle off camera smoothing when you get hard-corrected
 You now have the ability to have the aiming laser play past the your cursor, showing full length at all times
Other notable bugfixes
 [Minimap vision cone] Fixed issue where vision cones on the minimap become pixelated/low res
 [Abyss Aiming] Fixed a bug where abyss aiming was off by about 40 units depending on camera angle.
 [Joule] Fixed a bug where the warmup state VFX on Joule’s Lightning Strike (Q) would linger after the projectile fires
 [Joule] Fixed a bug that was causing Joule’s Jolt (LMB) hits to incorrectly reduce the cooldown of Surge (Shift) 
 [Powers] Two-way Telporter should now accurately use the visuals of a Basecamp when determining whether it's in the teleport area or not
 [Felix] Fixed a bug with Felix’s Flight of the Firefox (R) that prevented his Level 2 upgrade from working properly
 [Reconnect] Hunters should no longer sail into the sky when crashing while mid-physics motion
 [Performance] Addressed an issue causing crashes with some older AMD GPUs
 [Celeste] Fixed an issue that caused Celeste to sometimes get stuck while using Skate (Shift) (shoutout to DUNMUIR for calling this out to us!) 
 [Zeph] Fixed an issue causing Vortex Charm (Q) to sometimes not hit large enemies reliably
 [Bishop] Fixed an issue causing Bishop’s Rocket Launcher (LMB) to double hit targets near terrain
 [Jin] Fixed an issue causing the third hit of Ash’gara Warblade (LMB) to be stuck sometimes
 [Kingpin] Fixed an issue causing Abyssal Grasp (RMB) to sometimes pull allies/enemies underground
